apps.name: AEO Boost for Zid
apps.description:
Overview

AEO Boost helps Zid merchants improve product pages and their readiness for discovery in AI search and answers, including Google and ChatGPT. It audits a product page, displays a readiness score, and identifies improvements with practical recommendations to strengthen product content and support sales.

Key Features

- Select products inside the Zid dashboard with product names and images.
- Review product-page readiness scores and prioritized improvements.
- Get recommendations for descriptions, specifications, FAQs, and Product structured data.
- Review and copy suggested content before applying it.
- Access saved reports with audit dates, re-audit products, and compare results after making improvements.
- Try a one-day trial with one free score-only audit. Activate a paid subscription to unlock the full report.

Activation Guide

1. Choose a suitable plan on the app's Zid App Market page and install the app.
2. Authorize the connection, then open the app from My Apps in the Zid dashboard.
3. Select a product and start the audit.
4. Open the report and review the recommended priorities and suggested content.
5. Verify the suggestions, apply the changes manually to your product page, and re-audit to compare results.

The app audits pages and provides recommendations. Merchants apply product changes manually. Opening saved reports does not consume credits.
apps.short_description: Improve product pages for AI search and answers with practical, copy-ready recommendations.

apps.name: Nexa
apps.description:
NEXA is a 24/7 sales and support assistant for your Zid store.

Shoppers ask about products, prices, delivery and their orders at all hours. NEXA answers instantly, in natural Arabic, using your store's real data.

• Answers from your store: products, prices, availability, shipping and payment methods, read live from Zid.
• Sells for you: adds and updates items in the shopper's real store cart during the chat.
• Completes the order: guides the shopper through address and shipping, then hands them to checkout ready to pay.
• Order tracking: shoppers ask "where's my order?" and get their own order status.
• WhatsApp + your store: one assistant on your storefront chat and on WhatsApp.
• Smart Inbox: every conversation in one place, and you can step in anytime.

Set up in a minute: install and your store connects automatically. The chat appears on your storefront with no coding needed.

Free 7-day trial.
apps.short_description: AI shop assistant that answers shoppers, fills their cart and completes orders.

apps.name: Wassal Flow
apps.description: Wassal Flow helps Zid merchants manage WhatsApp QR conversations, AI-assisted replies, abandoned cart follow-ups, customer synchronization, and marketing campaigns. The app uses store, customer, order, and cart data only to automate customer support, improve follow-up messages, and send merchant-approved WhatsApp messages.
apps.short_description: WhatsApp QR, AI replies, carts, and campaigns for Zid stores.

apps.name: Nabd - Live Sales Screen
apps.description:
Turn your office TV into a live sales screen your whole team can see.

Your store's sales usually sit in the Zid dashboard, where only the owner sees them. With Nabd, your packing, customer service and marketing teams see every new order within seconds, and know how much is left to the next bonus.

Features:
• Live within seconds: every new order appears right away, with a pop-up showing its amount and an optional chime.
• Bonus levels: up to 8 levels with the amounts and rewards you choose, a progress bar and the amount left to the next level.
• A celebration at every goal: confetti and a fanfare each time the team reaches a level.
• Daily or monthly goal: the counter restarts every midnight, or builds up until the end of the month.
• Chart: sales by hour to show your peak times, or by day for a monthly goal.
• Any screen, as many as you like: TV, monitor or phone, and the same link works on several screens at once.
• Arabic and English.

Honest numbers, respected privacy:
• Cancelled, returned and unpaid orders don't count, and an order cancelled after it appears is subtracted automatically.
• The screen never shows payment details, phone numbers or addresses, and customer names are hidden by default.
• Your screen link is private. You can replace it with one click, and the old link stops working immediately.
• Nabd only reads orders and never changes anything in your store.

Ready in three steps:
1. Install Nabd from the Zid App Market and go straight to your dashboard.
2. Set your goals and rewards.
3. Open your screen link on the office TV.

No passwords, no software to install. 7-day free trial, then just 9 SAR once instead of 19 SAR.
apps.short_description: Live sales screen for your Zid store on the office TV, with bonus levels that motivate your team.

apps.name: Pblish
apps.description:
**Pblish** is a creative automation and content generation platform that enables merchants to produce, manage, and distribute high-performing visual content at scale. It connects product catalogs with dynamic templates to **generate ready-to-publish creatives for ads**, social media, and e-commerce use cases.

With Zid access, Pblish will securely read product data (images, titles, pricing, inventory) and automate content-creation workflows. This allows merchants to instantly generate localized, on-brand creatives directly from their Zid catalog, reducing manual design effort and accelerating go-to-market speed.

The integration will be embedded, operating as an external service that syncs with Zid stores to fetch data and push generated assets where applicable.
apps.short_description: Automate product-based creatives from the Zid catalog via API for ads and social media at scale.
